commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: When wealth falls to someone who does their duty to others, it is like a useful tree bearing fruit in the middle of the village. Of all worldly justice this duty is the best, so it is the goodness meant here. It gives everyone its use with ease.
